timeline.summary: IEX clarified that recent news on CERC draft market coupling norms is part of a regulatory stakeholder consultation exercise.
IEX scheduled its Q4FY26 earnings conference call for April 24, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹174.3 Cr (+22.5% YoY), net profit ₹129.77 Cr (+10.8% YoY).
2026-04-24: IEX posts Q4FY26 earnings call audio recording on company website
IEX reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹196.4 Cr (+12.5% YoY) and PAT of ₹129.8 Cr (+10.8% YoY), alongside a final dividend of ₹2 per share.
IEX reports April 2026 power market volumes: total electricity traded 12,341 MU (+16.6% YoY), with RTM at 5,069 MU (+30.2% YoY)
Incorporated wholly owned subsidiary Indian Coal Exchange Limited with authorized capital of ₹100 Cr to operate an online coal trading platform.

Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹167.1 Cr (+8.6% YoY), net profit ₹139.24 Cr (+12.9% YoY) (includes ₹11.05 Cr from discontinued operations; continuing operations ₹128.19 Cr).
